name: LP333 p37q3 phase-seeded Kissat from tabu objective 6368
hypothesis: A semantics-preserving literal renaming that maps Kissat's forced all-true initial primary phases to the independently audited objective-6368 unrestricted tabu endpoint may find an LP333 SAT model more quickly than default phases.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second Kissat 4.0.4 run at seed 0 on the exact unrestricted p37q3 CNF after the SHA-256-pinned 334-variable literal renaming, with phase true, forcephase true, and rephase false
claim_boundary: Only a complete transformed model that satisfies the renamed CNF, decodes through the inverse literal map, satisfies the original unrestricted p37q3 CNF, and independently verifies both length-333 rows plus all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations is a candidate. UNKNOWN and proofless UNSAT decide nothing.

baseline.evidence: The independently audited full-neighborhood tabu endpoint has squared residual 6368, L1 residual 784, maximum absolute residual 20, both row sums one, and all 74 prescribed p37q3 compression margins.
baseline.measurement: The renamed CNF has 700291 variables and 4394496 clauses, identical to the original dimensions. A full independent stream audit verified all 15073645 literal occurrences and all 666 primary phase mappings.

intervention.one_change: Rename exactly the 334 primary variables whose heuristic signs are positive so that renamed phase true represents every one of the 666 heuristic coordinates, then freeze Kissat phase true with forcephase true and rephase false; all clauses and auxiliary variables remain semantically equivalent.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a transformed or decoded model without direct verification

primary_metric.name: directly verified SAT model for the unrestricted p37q3 slice

terminal_outcomes.promote: Kissat returns SAT and the transformed-CNF, inverse-renaming, original-CNF, compression, and direct LP333 audits all pass.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen 3600-second run returns no SAT model; preserve UNKNOWN or proofless UNSAT as nondecisive workload evidence.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before a terminal manifest is written.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any formula hash, literal-renaming, heuristic mapping, tool pin, positive control, transformed model, decoded model, original CNF, compression, or direct LP333 check fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned transformed formula and scripts with Kissat seed 0, phase true, forcephase true, and rephase false.
Use exactly the objective-6368 tabu heuristic and 334-variable flip set.
Stop immediately after a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without a second phase policy, seed, heuristic, or cap.
Do not interpret UNKNOWN or proofless UNSAT as a slice or existence decision.
Do not promote a SAT marker until both transformed and decoded direct audits pass.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, construct H668, verify exact orthogonality and artifact hashes independently, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the endpoint and compare its exact solver telemetry with the default Kissat and parity-recovery arms before selecting another distinct exact mechanism.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula map, phase runner, decoder, compression check, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local source-pinned formulas, solver binaries, public prompt artifacts, and generated local results are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
